subject: Post-demo pricing recap & target $/1M benchmarking
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jillian Park <jillian.park@healix.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo pricing recap & target $/1M benchmarking

Hi Jillian —

Thanks again for walking through the inference demo today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put together a tailored pilot proposal: 

What I heard
- Pilot scope: NLU enrichment for claims processing (entity extraction + summarization).
- Expected cadence: small pilot first 1M tokens, then scale to ~10–25M tokens/mo if latency/quality look good.
- Current cost baseline: you mentioned roughly $20 per 1M tokens through your current host for the model you run.

Asks to finalize pricing benchmarks and the pilot proposal
1) Confirm expected steady-state monthly tokens (best guess range: e.g., 10–25M).
2) Share an initial target $/1M token you’d view as acceptable for a production SLA (range is fine).
3) Any constraints on billing (PO vs card, net terms) or procurement timeline?

What I’ll send next
- A short benchmarking sheet that compares Redwood hosted and dedicated pricing vs OpenAI/Anthropic and two common open-model hosts we track.
- A draft pilot commercial that includes an introductory pilot price and clear conversion path to committed capacity.

Attachment: Healix-pricing-benchmarks-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

If you’re free Monday I can block 30 mins to walk through the benchmarks and procurement steps with your procurement lead.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai

[attachment: Healix-pricing-benchmarks-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Jillian Park <jillian.park@healix.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <procurement@healix.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo pricing recap & target $/1M benchmarking

Hi Camila —

Appreciate the recap and the fast follow. Confirming our current thinking:
- Pilot: 1M tokens (2–3 week proof of concept)
- Expected steady state after pilot: 12–20M tokens/month (conservative/optimistic split)
- Target $/1M tokens for production: ideally in the $12–15 range. That would make the economics work for our team.
- Current host: we’re seeing ~$20/1M on the stack we use today (hosted open model).

Procurement notes:
- We prefer PO and standard 30–45 day net terms for enterprise pilots.
- Standard vendor questionnaire and SOC 2 evidence will be required — procurement looped in here.

Happy to take a short run-through of your benchmarking Monday; procurement is available in the afternoon.

Best,
Jillian Park
Head of Product, Healix AI
jillian.park@healix.ai

[signature: Healix AI | jillian.park@healix.ai | +1 415-555-0119]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jillian Park <jillian.park@healix.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo pricing recap & target $/1M benchmarking

Thanks Jillian — this is super helpful and aligns with what I expected. A few quick items and next steps: 

Pricing signal and pilot suggestion
- Based on your target $12–15/1M and the 12–20M steady state, I will prepare two commercial paths:
  a) Hosted pilot + conversion to committed Dedicated capacity (recommended for predictable unit cost and SLA).
  b) Short-term hosted with model/quantization tune to push unit cost down (faster to start but less predictability).
- Preliminary: we can offer a pilot rate of $14/1M for the 1M POC if Healix signs a conversion option to a 12-month commitment at a mutually agreed monthly token tier. I’ll surface the exact tiered breakpoints in the proposal.

Procurement & evidence
- I’ll attach the SOC 2 summary and a compressed evidence packet for your procurement team. If they need the full report or an on-site brief, we can coordinate that with our security team.

Meeting
- Can we do Mon 30 Aug at 2:00pm PT to walk through the spreadsheet and procurement asks? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and loop in procurement.

Attachments: proposal-draft-HXL-021.pdf (initial commercial draft), Healix-pricing-benchmarks-v1.xlsx (updated)

Next: I’ll also loop in Ben for a quick pricing approval on the pilot discount and conversion terms.

Thanks —
Camila

[attachment: proposal-draft-HXL-021.pdf (pdf)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo pricing recap & target $/1M benchmarking — approval request (HXL-2027-021)

Laura / Ben — forwarding the thread with Healix. Key points:
- Pilot: 1M tokens POC, target steady-state 12–20M/mo.
- Customer target price band: $12–15/1M; their current host costs ~ $20/1M.
- Proposed commercial: pilot @ $14/1M with conversion option to a 12-month committed tier (tiered pricing to follow).
- Procurement requires PO + 30–45 day net terms and SOC 2 artifacts.

Requesting:
1) Ben — sign-off on offering pilot at $14/1M with requirement that the conversion is agreed within 45 days and committed tier details are finalized. If you prefer different conversion language I can adjust.
2) Laura — confirm we can provide the compressed SOC 2 evidence packet and the standard procurement addendum (I attached the draft proposal and benchmark sheet).

Attachments: Healix-pricing-benchmarks-v1.xlsx, proposal-draft-HXL-021.pdf
